title: Evaluating the evolutionary relationship of TATA binding protein (TBP) with various folding patterns of protein domains using support vector machine (SVM).
one_liner_zh: 该文用SVM和随机森林整合结构、序列分析TBP（TFIID）与其他蛋白折叠的进化关系，虽涉及TF-DNA相关蛋白但未聚焦结合互作机制，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: This study focuses on the TATA-box binding, transcription initiation factor TFIID protein, (1tba) and employs a comprehensive approach combining structural, sequence and machine learning-based analysis to investigate its evolutionary relationships. By examining the TATA-box binding like protein, the study aims to identify similarities with other known protein folds, shedding light on its evolutionary relationship, and functional connections. To validate these relationships, a support vector machine (SVM) based algorithm was developed, which was complemented by another machine learning technique random forest, to ensure robust and reliable results. The integrated findings from structural, sequence, and machine learning analysis revealed several domain folds evolutionary related to TATA-box binding protein-like (1tba, B). The SVM-based method developed in this study serves as a valuable tool for identifying novel or functionally similar TATA-box binding proteins, providing deeper insights into their evolutionary and structural relationships. This work not only advances our understanding of the TATA-box binding protein family but also demonstrates the power of integrating computational and machine learning approaches in protein evolution research.
abstract_zh: 本研究聚焦于TATA-box结合蛋白、转录起始因子TFIID蛋白（1tba），并采用结构、序列及基于机器学习分析的综合方法来探究其进化关系。通过考察TATA-box结合样蛋白，本研究旨在识别与其他已知蛋白质折叠的相似性，揭示其进化关系及功能联系。为验证这些关系，开发了一种基于支持向量机（SVM）的算法，并辅以另一种机器学习技术——随机森林，以确保结果的稳健性和可靠性。结构、序列及机器学习分析的综合发现揭示了多个与TATA-box结合蛋白样（1tba, B）进化相关的结构域折叠。本研究中开发的基于SVM的方法作为识别新型或功能相似的TATA-box结合蛋白的有力工具，为其进化与结构关系提供了更深入的见解。这项工作不仅增进了我们对TATA-box结合蛋白家族的理解，也展示了计算与机器学习方法在蛋白质进化研究中整合的力量。
